title: (RHBA-2015:1717) ovirt-host-deploy fixes and enhancement update [ part of 3.5.4 ]
portal_synopsis: ovirt-host-deploy fixes and enhancement update [ part of 3.5.4 ]
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Updated ovirt-host-deploy packages are now available.

The ovirt-host-deploy packages provide deployment implementation required for
Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization Manager to deploy new hosts. The packages
contain a Python library and Java library used by the Red Hat Enterprise
Virtualization Manager package. These libraries are the core deployment logic.

Changes to the ovirt-host-deploy component:

* Previously, the following error message would be displayed when the kdump
service failed to start: "Command '/sbin/service' failed to execute". This error
message was unclear, and users would need to read the log files to determine
that the kdump service had failed to start. With this update, the following
message is now displayed in these circumstances: "kdump service restart failed.
Please either redeploy with Kdump Integration disabled or fix kdump
configuration manually and redeploy the host". This message provides clear
indication to users in the Events tab, and prevents the need to read the log
files to identify which service failed to start. (BZ#1247516)
